metadata.description: Sales execution skills for B2B service companies: discovery prep, call scripts, value propositions, offer ladder, proposals, pipeline analysis, qualification, delivery process, slide decks.

plugins.name: sales-engine
plugins.description: 9 Claude Code skills that execute the sales block of a GTM system for B2B service companies: pre-call meeting prep (≤500-word briefs), cold-call scripts, value proposition listing, an offer ladder, branded proposals (call deck + send version) pipeline analysis with actionable follow-ups, deal qualification (SCOPE, mappable to MEDDPICC/BANT), the buyer-facing delivery process (how we work), and a slide deck builder (.pptx from a document). Built and battle-tested by Victor Shulga (Fractional CRO).
